title: Calendar Afternoon Fragmentation
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:freebusy
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=13 AND hour<18
| bin _time span=1d
| stats dc(slot_start) as busy_blocks, sum(busy_min) as busy_min by _time
| where busy_blocks>5 AND busy_min>180
| sort - busy_blocks
description: Uses Calendar free-busy blocks telemetry to monitor how fragmented afternoon time becomes in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for days where deep work is unlikely because the afternoon is chopped up, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Calendar free-busy blocks data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how fragmented afternoon time becomes so you can spot days where deep work is unlikely because the afternoon is chopped up before it becomes annoying.
